definitions.aggregate_throughput: Sum over the cell's UEs of UDP payload received per second (app), and of newTx TBS scheduled per second (mac).
definitions.decision_latency: Scheduler decision time per logged slot (`t=` of `Slot decisions`).
definitions.delay: One-way UDP delay, receiver clock minus sender clock (one host clock), of delivered packets.
definitions.delay_radio: Radio-time delay: (link sample at arrival - packet's target sample) / fs. The wall-clock delay (receiver minus sender host clock) is also reported; it scales with the run's radio speed.
definitions.gbr_satisfaction: Not measurable: srsUE carries one default non-GBR QoS flow per PDU session, so no GBR target exists to satisfy.
definitions.harq_first_tx_bler: Share of HARQ transport blocks not delivered by their first transmission (retransmitted or discarded), from the scheduler log. The gNB-metrics BLER counts every transmission.
definitions.harq_recovery_rate: Share of the transport blocks that failed their first transmission which a retransmission then delivered.
definitions.harq_residual_bler: Share of HARQ transport blocks the gNB discarded (maximum retransmissions, retransmission or feedback timeout): what HARQ did not recover and RLC or the application must.
definitions.harq_rtt: Radio time between consecutive transmissions of one transport block (HARQ round trip plus the scheduler's retransmission wait).
definitions.harq_tx_per_tb: Transmissions per HARQ transport block, first one included (1.0 = no retransmission).
definitions.jain_fairness: Jain's index (sum x)^2 / (n sum x^2) over the cell's UEs, for DL throughput, DL throughput divided by offered load, and DL PRB share. 1 = equal, 1/n = one UE takes all.
definitions.packet_drop: Share of sent packets never received (after the drain window).
definitions.pdb_violation: Share of offered packets whose radio-time delay exceeds the UE's 5QI PDB, or never arrived.
definitions.per_ue_throughput: Per UE, UDP payload received per second, against the offered load.
definitions.prb_utilization: Granted PRBs (UE + common) / (106 PRBs x 1000 slots) per radio second.
definitions.radio_time: Segment k = radio second k after measurement sample S0: samples [S0 + k*fs, S0 + (k+1)*fs) of the link concerned. Identical channel updates and offered packets fall in it in every run.
definitions.real_time_ratio: Radio samples per wall second / the cell's sample rate on the gNB receive link (1.0 = real time).
definitions.resource_utilization: PRBs granted (UE + common) / (PRBs in the carrier x slots), from the SCHED log.
definitions.spectral_efficiency: Bits per second per Hz of the 20 MHz carrier: delivered UDP payload (app) and newTx TBS (mac); 'per used PRB' divides TBS by the granted PRB bandwidth only.
definitions.starvation: DL: time from a newTx grant that left data waiting (dl_bo > 0) to the UE's next newTx grant. An event is a wait longer than 20 ms. UL: gap between newTx grants.
definitions.throughput_radio: Delivered UDP payload per radio second (bytes arriving in the segment, mapped through the UE's own link clock). A slow run delivers the same radio-time throughput in more wall time.
